pages.title: Graviton Condenser
pages.text: Quantises gravity itself - gravitons, spin foam and the anchors of reality. The problem physics has failed at for a century.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 4$() machine.

The $(thing)graviton$() is the hypothetical massless spin-2 particle carrying gravity, never detected; one would be absurdly hard to catch. $(thing)Spin foam$() comes from loop quantum gravity, where spacetime itself is a network of discrete quanta. The $(item)Graviton Condenser$() treats both as feedstock.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 2 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Bulk Crystal, Bulk Stone, Graviton Crystal, Graviton Wisp Core, Rift Anchor, Spacetime Anchor Core, Spin Foam Lattice, Universe Seed.
